unit: MB RSS (cgroup memory.current) per concurrent SSE stub stream
honesty: NOT a live nine-stage capacity RPS. Stub LLM, AUTH off, Tier-2 off, sidecar WEB_CONCURRENCY=1. Shared compose gateway was not recreated and was not load-tested.
interpretation: Absolute soak delta stayed ~4.5 MB at both 4 and 8 in-flight, so a large fraction is worker warmup/noise. Per-stream SSE hold of a 3s / 50 tok/s stub is small. Publish 1.1 MB (n=4) with a conservative cap of 2 MB/stream for later fleet math — not a precision constant.
